text: 2.5GBASE-T and 5GBASE-T (802.3bz, 2016) exist primarily to serve what purpose?
choices: To support new data centre fabrics
To extract multi-gigabit rates from the enormous installed base of Cat5e and Cat6 cable, avoiding replacement
To support longer distances than 100 m
explanation: The world contains an enormous quantity of Category 5e, and replacing it building by building is prohibitively expensive. Using PAM-4 and heavy DSP, 802.3bz reaches 2.5 and 5 Gb/s over the same 100 m — a direct illustration that a medium's properties are a function of the current manufacturing art.
